name: Otisdub Tag Plus
summary:
# About

Otisdub Tag Plus is Otisdub Tag, but better! With more maps, gamemodes, music, and cosmetics, Otisdub Tag Plus provides a better experience.

# Maps

- Outdoors: It is in the name. It it just outside.
- Cosmetics: It has all the cosmetics and a few computers so you can change what people see you as in game.
- Beach: Relax in the beach!
- Horror: Run away from the monster as fast as you can!

# Better Features

- More maps
- More gamemodes
- An LIV camera
- Music
- More!
